title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 5 项，AI × Bio 13 项，AI × Math 0 项，AI Voices 6 项，Engineering 4 项。今日五频道共同日期为 2026-09-13。化学与生物焦点均来自尚未经同行评议的预印本，分别涵盖肽设计表征、肿瘤免疫与神经母细胞瘤等；AI Voices 收录公开帖文，其中基准定位和性能数字仅代表发布方表述。工程侧入选 GitHub Trending 开源项目快照，并非软件正式发布；AI×Math 因候选不足暂不推荐。

channel_highlights.aixchem: AI×Chem 今日精选均为预印本：肽设计的化学描述符与深度表示比较居首，其跨数据分布与前瞻设计任务中的泛化仍待检验。
channel_highlights.aixbio: AI×Bio 今日精选均为预印本；TIME_ACT 聚焦跨癌种免疫治疗应答预测，相关生物标志物价值仍需前瞻性临床验证。
channel_highlights.aixmath: AI×Math 今日没有足够高质量更新：arXiv 抓取受限、OpenReview 无候选，故不作补选或推断。
channel_highlights.aivoices: AI Voices 重点为公开帖文：ARC Prize 宣布 ARC-AGI-4 的定位，Cohere 的翻译基准分数均应视为发布方陈述。
channel_highlights.engineering: 工程频道精选 GitHub Trending 项目快照，包括智能体应用合集、YuE2 音乐生成与 worktree 工具；它们不是正式软件发布，生产可用性需另行核验。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 帖文转述 DeepMind 与 Janelia 开源可在物理引擎运行的数字果蝇
breaking_news.summary_zh: 一则高互动 X 帖文称，Google DeepMind 与 HHMI Janelia 将由显微数据逐关节重建的 flybody 以 Apache 2.0 开源；该数字果蝇可在本地物理引擎中行走、抓握、飞行和着陆。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 这把神经连接、动物形态与具身仿真汇入可复用的开放研究资产，可能改变神经科学、机器人与生物物理建模的实验入口。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 帖文报告生成式 AI 发现药物 rentosertib 进入 III 期临床
breaking_news.summary_zh: X 帖文报告，rentosertib 已进入 III 期临床，并称其为首个进入该阶段的生成式 AI 发现药物；原帖同时列出其 IIa 期高剂量组与安慰剂组的肺功能变化数据。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 若该临床推进如帖文所述，AI 分子设计将首次越过早期验证，进入决定临床价值与研发生产率的关键阶段。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 研究者公布对 Erdős 第364题相关猜想的部分推进，并以 Lean 形式化检验
breaking_news.summary_zh: 数学研究者 Chey Loveday 公布一篇预印本，称其处理了 Erdős 第364题中“平方中项”扇区，触及 Erdős–Mollin–Walsh 关于不存在三个连续强数的猜想；完整问题仍未解决。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它不是宣布解开原猜想，而是把开放问题推进到可界定子问题，并把人机协作探索、传统证明与 Lean 形式化连接成可审计的证明流程。

items.title: Chemical Descriptors and Deep Learning Embeddings for Scoring de novo Peptide Designs
items.abstract_or_text: Peptides occupy a valuable niche between small molecules and biologics, but the clinical translation of de novo peptide designs requires rigorous scoring to simultaneously optimise target binding affinity alongside multiple developability traits, including stability, membrane permeability, aggregation propensity, and non-fouling behaviour. Here, we evaluate two distinct approaches for scoring these candidates: classical chemical descriptors and modern deep learning representations derived from protein language and folding models. Assembling nine public datasets spanning five developability traits and four binding-affinity endpoints, we find sequence-derived chemical descriptors alone contain sufficient information to predict developability task labels effectively. Given their drastically lower computational cost and higher interpretability, classical machine learning models trained on these simple descriptors frequently match or approach the performance of complex deep learning architectures, emerging as a highly efficient and interpretable alternative for high-throughput scoring. Finally, for scoring binding affinity, we demonstrate that Boltz-2 pair representations capture the most information among the tested representations; however, the model's predictive power is confounded by a significant bias from the molecular weight of the peptides. Together, these results establish a comprehensive assessment of state-of-the-art methods for predicting both peptide developability and binding affinity, highlighting the enduring value of interpretable chemical descriptors alongside deep learning in the scoring and selection of de novo peptide designs.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在9个公开数据集上比较序列化学描述符与蛋白语言/折叠模型深度表示，用于预测从头设计肽的5类可开发性性状和4类结合亲和力终点。结果表明，简单可解释的化学描述符模型常可达到或接近复杂深度模型的表现；Boltz-2 pair 表示的信息量最高，但其亲和力预测受肽分子量显著混杂。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为从头肽药设计中的高通量筛选提供了低计算成本、可解释的基线，也具体揭示了 Boltz-2 表示的分子量偏倚。结论基于汇集的公开数据集，跨数据分布和真实前瞻设计任务中的泛化仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 肽在小分子和生物制剂之间占据有价值的位置，但从头设计肽的临床转化需要严格的评分体系，以同时优化靶标结合亲和力以及多项可开发性性状，包括稳定性、膜通透性、聚集倾向和抗污行为。在此，我们评估了用于评价这些候选物的两类不同方法：经典化学描述符，以及源自蛋白语言和折叠模型的现代深度学习表示。我们汇集了9个公开数据集，涵盖5项可开发性性状和4个结合亲和力终点，发现仅基于序列的化学描述符就包含足以有效预测可开发性任务标签的信息。鉴于其计算成本大幅更低且可解释性更高，基于这些简单描述符训练的经典机器学习模型常常能够匹配或接近复杂深度学习架构的性能，成为高通量评分中高效且可解释的替代方案。最后，对于结合亲和力评分，我们证明 Boltz-2 pair 表示在所测试表示中捕获的信息最多；然而，该模型的预测能力受到肽分子量显著偏倚的混杂。总体而言，这些结果对预测肽可开发性和结合亲和力的最新方法进行了全面评估，凸显了在从头设计肽的评分与选择中，可解释化学描述符与深度学习并存的持久价值。

items.title: The small molecule inhibitor SU056-mediated targeting of YB1 inhibits the Rb pathway in triple-negative breast cancer tumors
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) tumors lack expression of estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), and HER2, limiting the availability of targeted therapeutic options. As a result, TNBC is characterized by a high propensity for metastasis, rapid recurrence, and poor overall prognosis. Despite significant research efforts, the molecular mechanisms that drive TNBC progression and metastasis remain incompletely understood. Y box binding protein 1 (YB1) is a multifunctional DNA/RNA-binding protein that regulates transcription, translation, and mRNA stability. Aberrant activation of YB1 has been implicated in multiple oncogenic processes, including proliferation, survival, invasion, metastasis, and therapy resistance in several cancer types, including TNBC. Our investigations have revealed a central role for YB1 in regulating key hallmarks of cancer that drive TNBC tumor progression and metastatic dissemination. Methods: Cell viability and drug sensitivity in TNBC cell lines were assessed using the MTT assay to determine IC50 values for pharmacologic inhibitors. Western blotting and quantitative RT PCR were used to quantify protein and mRNA expression levels in TNBC cell lines and tumor samples. Oncogenic phenotypes were evaluated using 2D colony formation assays, 3D tumorsphere growth assays, limiting dilution, and transwell migration assays to assess proliferative, stem-like, and migratory capacities. Cell cycle progression was analyzed using flow cytometry based assays. In vivo therapeutic efficacy was evaluated using preclinical xenograft and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models of TNBC to assess tumor growth and metastatic progression following treatment. Results: Our studies demonstrate that the small-molecule inhibitor SU056, which specifically targets YB1 for degradation, significantly suppresses the oncogenic behavior of TNBC cell lines and tumors. Pharmacologic inhibition of YB1 reduced TNBC cell proliferation, clonogenic growth, tumorsphere formation, stemness and migratory capacity. Importantly, combined treatment with SU056 and the CDK4/6 inhibitor Palbociclib enhanced the inhibitory effect on TNBC cell growth and tumor progression compared with either agent alone. Mechanistically, both genetic and pharmacologic targeting of YB1 suppressed TNBC tumor growth and metastatic potential through modulation of the Cyclin D/CDK4/6/Rb signaling axis, leading to inhibition of cell cycle progression and induction of G1 arrest. Conclusion: Collectively, these findings identify SU056/CDK4/6i combination as a potential therapeutic option for the treatment of Rb+ TNBC.
items.summary_zh: 研究报道小分子 SU056 通过促使 YB1 降解，抑制三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的增殖、克隆形成、肿瘤球形成、干性和迁移；其与 CDK4/6 抑制剂 Palbociclib 联用在细胞及异种移植和患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型中增强抑瘤效果。机制上，遗传和药理学靶向 YB1 均调节 Cyclin D/CDK4/6/Rb 轴并诱导 G1 阻滞。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将靶向蛋白降解的小分子策略与明确的 TNBC 体内模型及联合治疗联系起来，为 Rb+ TNBC 的药物发现提供了可检验的治疗假设。现有证据仍处于临床前预印本阶段，YB1 降解的选择性、安全窗和患者分层价值尚待独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）肿瘤不表达雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和 HER2，限制了靶向治疗选择。因此，TNBC 的特征是高转移倾向、快速复发和较差的总体预后。尽管开展了大量研究，驱动 TNBC 进展和转移的分子机制仍未被完全理解。Y box binding protein 1（YB1）是一种多功能 DNA/RNA 结合蛋白，调控转录、翻译和 mRNA 稳定性。YB1 的异常激活与包括 TNBC 在内的多种癌症中的多种致癌过程有关，包括增殖、存活、侵袭、转移和治疗耐药。我们的研究揭示，YB1 在调控驱动 TNBC 肿瘤进展和转移播散的关键癌症标志中发挥核心作用。方法：采用 MTT 测定法评估 TNBC 细胞系的细胞活力和药物敏感性，以确定药理学抑制剂的 IC50 值。采用 Western blotting 和定量 RT PCR 测定 TNBC 细胞系和肿瘤样本中的蛋白及 mRNA 表达水平。采用二维克隆形成实验、三维肿瘤球生长实验、极限稀释和 Transwell 迁移实验评估致癌表型，以评价增殖、干性和迁移能力。采用基于流式细胞术的检测分析细胞周期进程。在 TNBC 临床前异种移植和患者来源异种移植（PDX）小鼠模型中评估体内治疗疗效，以评价治疗后肿瘤生长和转移进展。结果：我们的研究表明，特异性靶向 YB1 并促使其降解的小分子抑制剂 SU056 可显著抑制 TNBC 细胞系和肿瘤的致癌行为。药理学抑制 YB1 降低了 TNBC 细胞增殖、克隆形成生长、肿瘤球形成、干性和迁移能力。重要的是，与任一药物单用相比，SU056 与 CDK4/6 抑制剂 Palbociclib 联合治疗对 TNBC 细胞生长和肿瘤进展的抑制作用更强。机制上，遗传和药理学靶向 YB1 均通过调节 Cyclin D/CDK4/6/Rb 信号轴抑制 TNBC 肿瘤生长和转移潜能，导致细胞周期进程受抑并诱导 G1 阻滞。结论：综上，这些发现表明 SU056/CDK4/6i 联合治疗可作为治疗 Rb+ TNBC 的潜在选择。

items.title: Predicting Capsid Protein Binding Sites in Single-Stranded RNA Viruses Using Machine Learning from Local Geometric Features
items.abstract_or_text: Selective recognition of viral RNA by capsid proteins is essential for genome packaging during the assembly of single-stranded RNA (ssRNA) viruses. However, identification of capsid protein binding sites in the RNA genome remains challenging because current experimental techniques are labor-intensive and low-throughput, motivating the development of computational approaches. Here, we present a sequence-based framework that integrates RNA tertiary structural modeling, local geometric feature extraction, and machine learning to predict capsid protein binding sites. Using the Qbeta; bacteriophage as a proof-of-concept system, we constructed a benchmark dataset of experimentally identified binding and non-binding RNA fragments. We designed a set of geometric descriptors to characterize the local structural features of the RNA backbone. When repeatedly trained and tested with these geometric descriptors on different subsets of the benchmark dataset, the neural network showed a strong ability to distinguish capsid protein binding sites from non-binding RNA fragments, achieving an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.88 in a 5-fold cross-validation. To evaluate whether the model can predict RNA binding sites without experimental structures, we applied it to local geometric features derived from AlphaFold-predicted RNA structures. Despite substantial structural differences between predicted and experimentally determined models, the classifier retained considerable predictive performance (AUC = 0.75), indicating that approximate RNA tertiary structures may still preserve biologically meaningful information for capsid binding site prediction. Furthermore, the failed predictions suggest that viral genome packaging is not only governed by intrinsic RNA structural features, but also by additional dynamic factors beyond static RNA conformations. In summary, our findings provide new mechanistic insights into RNA-capsid interactions and establish a foundation for extending this approach to diverse ssRNA viruses.
items.summary_zh: 该工作将 RNA 三级结构建模、局部几何特征和神经网络结合，用于预测单链 RNA 病毒衣壳蛋白结合位点。在 Qbeta; 噬菌体的实验注释 RNA 片段基准上，5折交叉验证 AUC 为0.88；使用 AlphaFold 预测 RNA 结构时仍获 AUC = 0.75。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将局部 RNA 几何信息引入病毒基因组包装位点预测，并同时比较实验结构与预测结构，提供了可量化的基准证据。验证仅限于 Qbeta; 体系且存在静态构象无法解释的失败案例，推广至其他 ssRNA 病毒前仍需实验检验。
items.abstract_zh: 衣壳蛋白对病毒 RNA 的选择性识别对于单链 RNA（ssRNA）病毒装配过程中的基因组包装至关重要。然而，鉴定 RNA 基因组中的衣壳蛋白结合位点仍具挑战性，因为现有实验技术劳动密集且通量低，这推动了计算方法的发展。在此，我们提出了一个基于序列的框架，整合 RNA 三级结构建模、局部几何特征提取和机器学习来预测衣壳蛋白结合位点。以 Qbeta; 噬菌体作为概念验证体系，我们构建了一个由实验鉴定的结合与非结合 RNA 片段组成的基准数据集。我们设计了一组几何描述符，用于表征 RNA 骨架的局部结构特征。当使用这些几何描述符在基准数据集的不同子集上重复训练和测试时，神经网络显示出区分衣壳蛋白结合位点与非结合 RNA 片段的强大能力，在5折交叉验证中实现了受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.88。为评估模型能否在没有实验结构的情况下预测 RNA 结合位点，我们将其应用于从 AlphaFold 预测 RNA 结构中获得的局部几何特征。尽管预测模型与实验确定模型之间存在显著结构差异，分类器仍保持了相当的预测性能（AUC = 0.75），表明近似 RNA 三级结构仍可能保留对衣壳结合位点预测具有生物学意义的信息。此外，预测失败提示，病毒基因组包装不仅受 RNA 内在结构特征支配，还受到静态 RNA 构象以外额外动态因素的影响。总之，我们的发现为 RNA-衣壳相互作用提供了新的机制见解，并为将该方法扩展至多种 ssRNA 病毒奠定了基础。

items.title: CasanovoGUI: a cross-platform desktop application for deep learning-based de novo peptide sequencing with Casanovo
items.abstract_or_text: De novo peptide sequencing detects peptides directly from tandem mass spectra without a protein sequence database, and deep learning has substantially advanced its performance. Casanovo, one such widely used model, is distributed as a Python command-line program. Consequently, installation, GPU and dependency configuration, and manual parameterization can be challenging for many bench scientists and are a recurring source of errors. Interpreting and validating the resulting predictions poses a further challenge. We present CasanovoGUI, an open-source Java-based desktop application that makes all of Casanovo's main analysis functions available through a point-and-click interface on Windows, macOS, and Linux. On first use, CasanovoGUI automatically installs a private Python environment and Casanovo with a GPU-matched build, requiring no prior software setup. The GUI provides access to Casanovo's analysis functions and configuration parameters, streams live progress, and integrates results interpretation: annotated spectra with per-residue confidence scores in the PDV viewer, and mismatch-tolerant mapping of de novo peptides back to a reference proteome. CasanovoGUI is available at https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI.
items.summary_zh: CasanovoGUI 是面向 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的开源 Java 桌面程序，将深度学习从头肽测序工具 Casanovo 的分析和参数设置封装为图形界面；首次使用可自动配置与 GPU 匹配的私有 Python 环境。软件还集成带逐残基置信度的谱图注释，以及将从头肽段容错映射回参考蛋白组的结果解释功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具降低了深度学习质谱肽测序的安装与结果审阅门槛，有助于将既有模型带入实验室工作流。摘要未提供与命令行版的性能或可用性对照，自动环境配置在不同硬件和依赖条件下的稳健性仍应由用户验证。
items.abstract_zh: 从头肽测序可直接从串联质谱中检测肽，而无需蛋白序列数据库；深度学习已显著提升其性能。Casanovo 是一种被广泛使用的此类模型，以 Python 命令行程序形式发布。因此，安装、GPU 和依赖项配置以及手动参数设置对许多实验科学家而言可能具有挑战性，并且是反复出现的错误来源。对所得预测结果的解释和验证构成了进一步挑战。我们提出 CasanovoGUI，这是一款开源的基于 Java 的桌面应用程序，通过点击式界面在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上提供 Casanovo 的全部主要分析功能。首次使用时，CasanovoGUI 会自动安装私有 Python 环境和具有 GPU 匹配构建的 Casanovo，无需任何既有软件配置。该 GUI 提供 Casanovo 分析功能和配置参数的访问、实时显示进度，并整合结果解读：在 PDV viewer 中显示带逐残基置信度评分的注释谱图，以及将从头肽段以容错方式映射回参考蛋白组。CasanovoGUI 可在 https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI 获取。

items.title: Selection for propagule formation in prebiotic chemical ecosystems
items.abstract_or_text: Biological individuals on Earth today are cellular, but the simplest cells are too complex to have arisen spontaneously. We explore the hypothesis that the emergence of biological individuality might have been driven by selection for different molecules to move through space together by forming a propagule. We predicted that propagule formation will be advantageous to an autocatalytic system primarily when 1) sites supporting autocatalysis are distantly spaced and 2) the environment undergoes periodic disturbances. We tested this hypothesis using computational reaction-diffusion models of surface-catalyzed autocatalytic systems in patchy, disturbance-prone environments. We considered two competing autocatalytic cycles, each composed of mutualistic subcycles, one of which diverts flux to the production of propagules. Our analysis shows that propagules tend to be detrimental in well-mixed environments or environments where viable surfaces are close enough together to be reliably seeded through single-species dispersal. However, propagule formation is advantageous when long stretches of empty space must be crossed to reach new resources and/or when environmental disturbances are frequent. These findings suggest spatial structure can selectively favor reliable forms of codispersal. Evolution in response to this mechanism could potentially explain the emergence of vesicles that transported many autocatalytic species and eventually became independent protocells.
items.summary_zh: 研究以表面催化自催化系统的计算反应-扩散模型考察原始化学生态系统中“传播体”形成的选择优势。模型显示，在自催化位点相距较远和环境周期性扰动时，包含多个分子共同迁移的传播体有利；在充分混合或可由单物种可靠播种的环境中则不利。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提出空间结构和扰动可选择性促进多组分共扩散，为原始细胞及囊泡出现提供了可形式化检验的机制假说。证据目前完全来自简化计算模型，尚不能证明这一选择过程在具体前生物化学体系中发生。
items.abstract_zh: 今天地球上的生物个体由细胞构成，但最简单的细胞也过于复杂，不可能自发产生。我们探索这样一种假说：生物个体性的出现可能是由不同分子通过形成传播体而共同在空间中移动所受的选择驱动。我们预测，当1）支持自催化的位点相距遥远，且2）环境经历周期性扰动时，传播体形成对于自催化系统将是有利的。我们使用斑块化、易受扰动环境中表面催化自催化系统的计算反应-扩散模型检验了这一假说。我们考虑了两个相互竞争的自催化循环，每个循环均由互利子循环组成，其中一个将通量转用于产生传播体。我们的分析表明，在充分混合的环境中，或在可存活表面彼此足够接近、能够通过单物种扩散可靠播种的环境中，传播体往往有害。然而，当必须跨越长距离空白空间以抵达新资源和/或环境扰动频繁时，传播体形成是有利的。这些发现表明，空间结构可以选择性地有利于可靠的共同扩散形式。响应这一机制的进化可能解释了囊泡的出现：这些囊泡运输许多自催化物种，并最终成为独立的原始细胞。

items.title: Pan-cancer prediction of tumor immune activation and response to immune checkpoint blockade from tumor transcriptomics and histopathology
items.abstract_or_text: Accurately predicting which patients will respond to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) remains a major challenge. Here, we present TIME_ACT, an unsupervised 66-gene transcriptomic signature of tumor immune activation derived from TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas) melanoma data. First, we demonstrate that TIME_ACT scores accurately identify tumors with activated immune microenvironments across different cancer types. Further, analysis of spatial features reveals that tumor microenvironment regions with dense lymphocyte infiltration near tumor cells have high TIME_ACT scores, successfully marking localized immune activation. Second, across 25 transcriptomic ICB cohorts encompassing nine cancer types, TIME_ACT achieves a mean AUC of 0.76 and a mean odds ratio of 5.77, significantly outperforming 30 established transcriptomic signatures and prediction methods for ICB response, including a recently developed foundation model for immunotherapy response prediction. Third, we show that TIME_ACT scores can be accurately inferred from routine tumor histopathology slides and that slide-inferred TIME_ACT scores predict ICB response across nine new independent patient cohorts spanning eight cancer types, achieving a mean AUC of 0.72 and a mean odds ratio of 4.99. These findings establish TIME_ACT as a robust, pan-cancer biomarker that enables accurate, low-cost, and clinically scalable prediction of ICB response from routine histopathology.
items.summary_zh: TIME_ACT 以泛癌转录组和病理切片预测肿瘤免疫活化及免疫检查点阻断应答。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究跨25个转录组 ICB 队列及9个独立病理队列进行评估，但其生物标志物效用仍需前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测哪些患者会对免疫检查点阻断（ICB）产生应答仍是一项重大挑战。我们提出 TIME_ACT：一个从 TCGA（The Cancer Genome Atlas）黑色素瘤数据中导出的、由66个基因构成的无监督肿瘤免疫活化转录组特征。首先，我们证明 TIME_ACT 评分可在不同癌种中准确识别具有活化免疫微环境的肿瘤。进一步对空间特征的分析显示，肿瘤细胞附近淋巴细胞浸润密集的肿瘤微环境区域具有较高的 TIME_ACT 评分，成功标记了局部免疫活化。其次，在涵盖9种癌症的25个转录组 ICB 队列中，TIME_ACT 的平均 AUC 为0.76、平均比值比为5.77，显著优于30个既有的 ICB 应答转录组特征和预测方法，包括一个近期开发的免疫治疗应答预测基础模型。第三，我们显示可从常规肿瘤组织病理切片中准确推断 TIME_ACT 评分，并且切片推断的 TIME_ACT 评分可在涵盖8种癌症的9个新的独立患者队列中预测 ICB 应答，平均 AUC 为0.72、平均比值比为4.99。这些发现确立 TIME_ACT 为一种稳健的泛癌生物标志物，可从常规组织病理学实现对 ICB 应答的准确、低成本且具有临床可扩展性的预测。

items.title: Preclinical trial supports dual inhibition of BCL2 and Aurora kinase A for MYCN -amplified high-risk neuroblastoma
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose: : Treatment for children with high-risk neuroblastoma relies on conventional chemotherapy and anti-GD2 immunotherapy. However, 5-year survival is only 50%, with high rates of late effects. Targeted therapy combinations are a major priority for these patients. The BCL2 inhibitor venetoclax, in combination with cyclophosphamide/topotecan, has clinical activity in relapsed and refractory neuroblastoma. We sought more effective and safer venetoclax combinations through systematic preclinical testing. Experimental design : Synergistic combinations were identified by high-throughput screening using patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models and confirmed in vivo . The leading combination (venetoclax-alisertib) was compared to combination chemotherapy in a clinical trial-like study using 22 PDX models, in scheduling experiments designed to reduce short-term toxicity, and in combination with anti-GD2 immunotherapy. BCL2 and Bim-BCL2 complex protein levels were assessed as predictors of sensitivity. Results: : In vitro synergy with venetoclax was observed for standard-of-care chemotherapies and targeted agents, including DNA topoisomerase, microtubule, HDAC and Aurora kinase A (AURKA) inhibitors. Venetoclax-alisertib was particularly effective in vivo . In an n=1 study, venetoclax-alisertib induced objective response in all models. Activity was most striking in models of MYCN -amplified disease (n=12), doubling median survival time compared to cyclophosphamide/topotecan, and outperforming venetoclax-cyclophosphamide-topotecan. Efficacy was maintained with discontinuous schedules, minimizing hematological toxicity without substantially compromising activity. PDX-engrafted animals treated with venetoclax-alisertib and anti-GD2 immunotherapy survived tumor-free long-term. BCL2 expression and BCL2-Bim complex levels were of limited value for predicting response. Conclusion: : Our findings support advancement of BCL2-AURKA inhibition to clinical trial for neuroblastoma with or without anti-GD2 immunotherapy, particularly in patients with MYCN amplified disease.
items.summary_zh: 在 MYCN 扩增高危神经母细胞瘤 PDX 中，venetoclax-alisertib 联合抑制显示出强于对照联合化疗的前临床活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 22个 PDX 模型及联合 anti-GD2 的体内实验提供了较强的转化前证据，但尚不是人体临床试验结果。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：高危神经母细胞瘤患儿的治疗依赖常规化疗和 anti-GD2 免疫治疗。然而，5年生存率仅为50%，且远期不良反应发生率高。靶向治疗组合是这些患者的一项重要优先事项。BCL2 抑制剂 venetoclax 与 cyclophosphamide/topotecan 联用，在复发和难治性神经母细胞瘤中具有临床活性。我们希望通过系统性前临床测试寻找更有效且更安全的 venetoclax 联合方案。实验设计：采用患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型的高通量筛选识别协同组合，并在体内加以确认。将领先组合 venetoclax-alisertib 与联合化疗在使用22个 PDX 模型的类临床试验研究中进行比较，在旨在降低短期毒性的给药方案实验中进行比较，并考察其与 anti-GD2 免疫治疗的联用。评估 BCL2 和 Bim-BCL2 复合物蛋白水平作为敏感性预测指标。结果：venetoclax 与标准治疗化疗药物及靶向药物均观察到体外协同作用，包括 DNA topoisomerase、microtubule、HDAC 和 Aurora kinase A（AURKA）抑制剂。venetoclax-alisertib 在体内尤其有效。在一项 n=1 研究中，venetoclax-alisertib 在全部模型中诱导客观应答。在 MYCN 扩增疾病模型中活性最为突出（n=12）：与 cyclophosphamide/topotecan 相比，生存时间中位数增加一倍，且优于 venetoclax-cyclophosphamide-topotecan。间歇给药方案仍保持疗效，在不显著损害活性的情况下减少了血液学毒性。接受 venetoclax-alisertib 与 anti-GD2 免疫治疗的 PDX 移植动物长期无瘤生存。BCL2 表达和 BCL2-Bim 复合物水平对预测应答的价值有限。结论：我们的发现支持推进 BCL2-AURKA 抑制进入神经母细胞瘤临床试验，无论是否联用 anti-GD2 免疫治疗；尤其适用于 MYCN 扩增疾病患者。

items.title: The Parkinson 's Disease Associated BAP1/ASXL3 Complex Regulates the Internalization of α-Synuclein Fibrils by Reprogramming the Cell Surface Glycoproteome
items.abstract_or_text: A central hallmark of Parkinson's disease (PD) is the spread of -Synuclein (-Syn) aggregates, which is thought to contribute to its progressive nature. To better understand the mechanism of cellular internalization of -Syn fibrils, we conducted a genome wide CRISPR activation (CRISPRa) screen to identify genetic modifiers of fibril uptake. We report here BRCA associated protein 1 (BAP1) as a regulator of fibril uptake into cells and validate its association with the genetic risk of PD. BAP1 regulates fibril entry into cells by acting as a master transcriptional regulator of the cell surface glycoproteome. BAP1 downregulates Heparan Sulfate Proteoglycan (HSPG) and upregulates O-linked glycoprotein expression, the net effect of which is to reduce fibril internalization. The effect of enhancing BAP1 expression is cell-type specific, as it reduces Syn uptake in iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons, but not in microglia. Using human midbrain organoids with integrated microglia, we find this effect is mediated through ASXL3 another PD risk gene and a non-obligatory component of the BAP1 Polycomb Repressive-Deubiquitinase Complex (PR-DUB). These findings are consistent with higher BAP1/ASXL3 co-expression in regions of the brain less vulnerable to PD pathology. Together, the work uncovers a novel role for BAP1/ASXL3 in regulating Syn fibril internalization by remodelling the cell surface glycoproteome.
items.summary_zh: 全基因组 CRISPRa 筛选和人中脑类器官研究将 BAP1/ASXL3 与 -Syn 纤维内吞调控联系起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究连接了 PD 风险基因、细胞表面糖蛋白组与 iPSC 神经元和类器官表型；其机制与治疗意义仍待进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 帕金森病（PD）的一个核心特征是 -Syn 聚集体的扩散，这被认为可能有助于其进行性特征。为更好理解 -Syn 纤维的细胞内吞机制，我们进行了全基因组 CRISPR activation（CRISPRa）筛选，以识别纤维摄取的遗传修饰因子。我们在此报告 BRCA associated protein 1（BAP1）是纤维摄取的调节因子，并验证其与 PD 遗传风险的关联。BAP1 作为细胞表面糖蛋白组的主转录调节因子，调控纤维进入细胞。BAP1 下调 Heparan Sulfate Proteoglycan（HSPG），并上调 O-linked glycoprotein 表达，净效应是降低纤维内吞。增强 BAP1 表达的作用具有细胞类型特异性：它降低 iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons 的 -Syn 摄取，但不降低 microglia 的摄取。利用整合 microglia 的人中脑类器官，我们发现该效应由 ASXL3 介导；ASXL3 是另一 PD 风险基因，也是 BAP1 Polycomb Repressive-Deubiquitinase Complex（PR-DUB）的非必需组分。这些发现与在较不易受 PD 病理影响的脑区中观察到的较高 BAP1/ASXL3 共表达一致。总之，该工作揭示 BAP1/ASXL3 通过重塑细胞表面糖蛋白组调控 -Syn 纤维内吞的新作用。

items.title: Benchmarking methods integrating GWAS and single-cell transcriptomic data for mapping trait-cell type associations
items.abstract_or_text: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have discovered numerous trait-associated variants, but their biological context remains unclear. Integrating GWAS summary statistics with single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data enables prioritization of cell types in which these variants influence traits. Existing methods broadly follow two strategies: single cell to GWAS, which identifies cell-type-specific genes and tests their enrichment in GWAS signals, and GWAS to single cell, which begins with GWAS-prioritized genes and scores cells or cell types according to their expression profiles. Here, we developed a literature-informed benchmark by integrating PubMed evidence with large language model-assisted literature synthesis to evaluate 20 trait-cell type mapping methods. We identify CATCH, a Cauchy combination of complementary methods, as the most robust overall approach, consistently achieving high statistical power while maintaining effective false-positive control across simulations and real-data benchmarks. We further identify key determinants of performance, including cell-type specificity metrics, GWAS statistical power, and the diversity of scRNA-seq reference datasets, providing practical guidance for the development and application of trait-cell type mapping methods.
items.summary_zh: 对20种整合 GWAS 与单细胞转录组数据的性状—细胞类型映射方法进行文献知情基准评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: CATCH 和性能决定因素的系统比较可为 GWAS 生物学解释提供方法选择依据，但不等同于确定具体性状的因果细胞类型。
items.abstract_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已发现大量与性状相关的变异，但其生物学背景仍不清楚。将 GWAS summary statistics 与 single-cell RNA-sequencing（scRNA-seq）数据整合，可优先识别这些变异影响性状的细胞类型。现有方法大体遵循两种策略：single cell to GWAS，即识别 cell-type-specific genes 并检验其在 GWAS signals 中的富集；以及 GWAS to single cell，即从 GWAS-prioritized genes 出发，按照细胞或细胞类型的表达谱对其评分。我们在此通过整合 PubMed 证据和 large language model-assisted literature synthesis，开发了一个 literature-informed benchmark，以评估20种性状—细胞类型映射方法。我们确定 CATCH（一种互补方法的 Cauchy combination）为整体上最稳健的方法：其在 simulations 和 real-data benchmarks 中持续实现较高的 statistical power，同时保持有效的 false-positive control。我们还识别了影响性能的关键决定因素，包括 cell-type specificity metrics、GWAS statistical power 以及 scRNA-seq reference datasets 的多样性，为性状—细胞类型映射方法的开发和应用提供实用指导。

items.title: DNT: Diploid Genomic Foundation Model
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical interpretation of genetic variation depends on the diploid genotype, including zygosity, allele dosage and whether multiple variants occur in cis on the same homologue or in trans on different homologues. Most genomic language models process haploid sequences or combine independently encoded haplotypes downstream, so they do not directly represent the paired genotype in a single sequence. We introduce a reference-aligned diploid encoding for single-nucleotide variants (SNVs) and short insertions and deletions (indels), together with unphased and phase-retaining tokenizers that accept phased genotypes and convert them to single-sequence diploid representation. Using Nucleotide Transformer v3 backbones, we continue training 8-million- and 100-million-parameter models and evaluate an auxiliary Contrastive Phase Loss (CPL) designed to retain the phasing information of the variants in contextual representations. We evaluate on a novel compound-heterozygous benchmark containing 9,460 examples. Models whose inputs did not distinguish relative phase remained near chance, whereas our diploidic models improved discrimination with AUROC 0.649, compared to 0.506 for the vocabulary-adapted control. These findings establish a method for making diploid genotype information accessible to genomic language models, rather than a universal improvement in variant prediction; validation in naturally observed, accurately phased clinical cohorts remains necessary.
items.summary_zh: DNT 以参考序列对齐的二倍体编码和相位保留 tokenizer，使 genomic language model 能表示相位信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在9,460例 compound-heterozygous 基准中显示相位辨别改善，但作者明确指出仍需在自然观察、准确相位的临床队列验证。
items.abstract_zh: 遗传变异的临床解读依赖二倍体基因型，包括 zygosity、allele dosage，以及多个变异是位于同一 homologue 的 cis 还是位于不同 homologues 的 trans。大多数 genomic language models 处理单倍体序列，或在下游组合独立编码的 haplotypes，因此无法在单一序列中直接表示成对的基因型。我们提出针对 single-nucleotide variants（SNVs）和短插入缺失（indels）的 reference-aligned diploid encoding，以及接受 phased genotypes 并将其转换为单序列二倍体表示的 unphased 和 phase-retaining tokenizers。使用 Nucleotide Transformer v3 backbones，我们继续训练了800万参数和1亿参数模型，并评估了一种旨在在 contextual representations 中保留变异 phasing information 的辅助 Contrastive Phase Loss（CPL）。我们在一个包含9,460个例子的新的 compound-heterozygous benchmark 上进行评估。输入未区分相对 phase 的模型性能接近随机，而我们的 diploidic models 将区分能力提高至 AUROC 0.649，相比之下 vocabulary-adapted control 为0.506。这些发现建立了一种使二倍体基因型信息可供 genomic language models 使用的方法，而非对变异预测的普遍改进；仍有必要在自然观察且准确 phased 的临床队列中验证。

items.title: An Automated, Contamination-Controlled VQA Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on 3D Oncology Imaging
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to medical imaging, yet public benchmarks may reward memorization over perception: their images and questions can enter pretraining corpora, and many items remain answerable from question text alone. We present an automated, agent-driven pipeline that builds multiple-choice benchmarks directly from paired private radiology reports and three-dimensional oncology imaging. It generates two complementary question types: schema-driven items populated deterministically from established reporting frameworks, and report-derived items verified against the source text. Because the source reports are private and single-institution, the resulting questions cannot have entered any model’s pretraining data, controlling instance-level contamination by construction. We applied the pipeline to four oncology cohorts (liver CT, liver MRI, lung CT and brain MRI; 2,509 cases and 33,870 questions) and evaluated five contemporary VLMs zero-shot. Accuracies ranged from 0.28 to 0.81 and no model was reliable across cohorts. Replacing the image with a blank input changed accuracy little for the highest-scoring models, and on schema-driven brain questions frontier models scored 0.17–0.19 higher on public than on matched private imaging. The benchmark thus separates image-dependent performance from question-text and dataset-familiarity effects, and the released pipeline lets institutions regenerate it on their own reports and images.
items.summary_zh: 一个从私有三维肿瘤影像和放射科报告自动生成的、控制预训练污染的 VQA 基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 2,509例、33,870题的多队列评估显示高分 VLM 未必依赖图像输入，且公开基准与私有匹配影像间存在表现差异。
items.abstract_zh: Vision-language models（VLMs）正日益应用于医学影像，但公开基准可能奖励记忆而非感知：其图像和问题可能进入预训练语料，且许多题目仅凭问题文本便可作答。我们提出一条自动化、agent-driven pipeline，直接从配对的私有放射学报告和三维肿瘤影像构建多项选择基准。它生成两类互补问题：由既定报告框架确定性填充的 schema-driven items，以及经源文本核验的 report-derived items。由于源报告是私有且来自单一机构，所得问题不可能进入任何模型的预训练，从构建上控制了实例层面的污染。我们将该 pipeline 应用于四个肿瘤队列（liver CT、liver MRI、lung CT 和 brain MRI；2,509例和33,870个问题），并以 zero-shot 方式评估五个当代 VLM。准确率范围为0.28至0.81，没有模型能在所有队列中可靠表现。将图像替换为空白输入后，最高分模型的准确率变化很小；对于 schema-driven brain questions，frontier models 在公开影像上的得分比匹配的私有影像高0.17–0.19。因此，该基准将依赖图像的表现与问题文本和数据集熟悉度效应区分开来；已发布的 pipeline 允许机构基于自身报告和影像重新生成该基准。
items.author_line: Liu B, Gu H, Li X, Zhu Z, Ellison J, Wang K, Sheng K, Braunstein S, Lupo J, Yang Y, Lin H

items.title: Automatic detection of depression in clinical interviews with large language models
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Accurate and timely detection of depression is essential for effective treatment, yet access to mental health services remains limited in many settings. Advances in artificial intelligence provide new opportunities to analyze language patterns in clinical interviews and support automated mental health assessment. In this study, we investigated whether automated analysis of interview conversations could detect major depressive disorder and whether automated transcription and ensemble strategies could improve scalability and performance. Structured clinical interview recordings from 299 Cantonese-speaking participants were analyzed, including 105 healthy controls and 194 patients diagnosed with major depressive disorder. Audio recordings were transcribed using both manual transcription and automatic speech recognition. Language-based classification models based on transformer architectures were developed using transcripts from both interviewer–interviewee interactions and interviewee-only speech. Individual models and ensemble approaches combining multiple models were evaluated. Automatic transcription substantially improved efficiency, reducing the average processing time per interview from approximately 45 minutes to 9.65 minutes, representing a 79% reduction. RoBERTa and DistilBERT were among the strongest individual models, and models using complete interviewer–interviewee interactions generally achieved higher AUCs than models using interviewee-only text. Ensemble modelling improved internal performance, although the magnitude of improvement varied across transcript conditions. In the independent external cohort, the final ensemble achieved an AUC of 0.75, similar to RoBERTa and slightly higher than DistilBERT. These findings support the feasibility of automated language analysis for depression detection while showing that transcription quality, conversational context, and external generalizability should be considered when interpreting model performance.
items.summary_zh: 在299名粤语受访者的临床访谈中，基于语言的模型以外部队列 AUC 0.75 识别重性抑郁障碍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究含独立外部队列并量化自动转录效率，但其结果支持可行性而非替代临床诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 准确且及时地检测抑郁症对于有效治疗至关重要，但许多地区获得心理健康服务的机会仍有限。人工智能的进展为分析临床访谈中的语言模式和支持自动化心理健康评估提供了新机会。在本研究中，我们考察了访谈对话的自动化分析能否检测 major depressive disorder，以及自动转录和集成策略能否提升可扩展性和性能。我们分析了299名粤语参与者的结构化临床访谈录音，包括105名健康对照和194名被诊断为 major depressive disorder 的患者。采用人工转录和 automatic speech recognition 两种方式转录音频。基于 transformer architectures 的语言分类模型使用 interviewer–interviewee interactions 的转录文本及仅含 interviewee speech 的转录文本开发。对单个模型和结合多个模型的 ensemble approaches 均进行了评估。自动转录显著提高效率，将每次访谈的平均处理时间从约45分钟降至9.65分钟，减少79%。RoBERTa 和 DistilBERT 属于最强的单个模型，且使用完整 interviewer–interviewee interactions 的模型通常比仅使用 interviewee-only text 的模型取得更高 AUC。Ensemble modelling 提高了内部性能，但提升幅度因转录条件而异。在独立外部队列中，最终 ensemble 达到 AUC 0.75，与 RoBERTa 相近，并略高于 DistilBERT。这些发现支持自动化语言分析用于抑郁症检测的可行性，同时表明解释模型性能时应考虑转录质量、对话语境和外部泛化能力。
items.author_line: Xian L, Chan KY, Chen J, Chan JWY, Chan NY, Huang B, Wing Y, Li TMH

items.title: Evaluating Open-Weight Large Language Models for Structured Depression Assessment from Clinical Interviews
items.abstract_or_text: The administration of semi-structured clinical interviews for depression assessment is resource-intensive and susceptible to rater drift. While large language models (LLMs) offer potential for automated quality assurance, reliance on proprietary models creates data privacy barriers incompatible with secure clinical workflows. This study evaluates a privacy-preserving pipeline using open-weight LLMs to perform item-level scoring of the Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) directly from interview transcripts. The sample included 541 video-recorded English-language interviews with 277 psychiatric inpatients diagnosed with diverse affective and psychotic disorders. Benchmarking 25 architectures, we found that an indirect scoring strategy, where models predict individual item scores that are subsequently summed, significantly outperformed direct total score prediction. This suggests that decomposing the assessment into intermediate reasoning steps improves performance. The best-performing models achieved “good” error rates and “excellent” correlations with trusted human labels, approaching established benchmarks for human inter-rater reliability. To determine the active ingredients of effective prompting, we conducted an ablation study. Results revealed that descriptive cues (scoring criteria) were the primary driver of performance, whereas few-shot examples provided negligible additional benefit, suggesting that zero-shot prompting is a viable, efficient strategy. However, error analysis identified a multimodal gap, where text-only models struggled more with items dependent on nonverbal behavior. We conclude that open-weight LLMs demonstrate strong potential to serve as secure “digital second opinions,” representing a promising step toward augmenting clinical decision-making without compromising patient privacy.
items.summary_zh: 对25种开放权重 LLM 进行 MADRS 逐项评分基准测试，探索隐私保护的临床访谈质量控制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 541段视频访谈和消融实验为可部署的开放模型提供证据，同时指出仅文本模型难以处理依赖非语言行为的条目。
items.abstract_zh: 抑郁症半结构化临床访谈的施行资源密集，且易受评分者漂移影响。尽管 large language models（LLMs）可用于自动化质量保证，但依赖专有模型会造成与安全临床工作流不相容的数据隐私障碍。本研究评估一种保护隐私的 pipeline：使用 open-weight LLMs 直接从访谈转录文本对 Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale（MADRS）进行逐项评分。样本包括541段英语视频访谈，来自277名被诊断为不同情感性和精神病性障碍的精神科住院患者。对25种架构进行基准测试后，我们发现间接评分策略——先由模型预测各条目分数、再将其相加——显著优于直接预测总分。这提示将评估分解为中间推理步骤可改善性能。最佳模型与可信人工标签之间取得“良好”的误差率和“极佳”的相关性，接近既有的人类评分者间信度基准。为确定有效 prompting 的活性成分，我们进行了 ablation study。结果表明，描述性线索（评分标准）是性能的主要驱动因素，而 few-shot examples 几乎未带来额外增益，表明 zero-shot prompting 是一种可行且高效的策略。然而，误差分析发现了 multimodal gap：纯文本模型在依赖非语言行为的条目上困难更大。我们得出结论，open-weight LLMs 具有作为安全“digital second opinions”的强大潜力，是在不损害患者隐私的情况下增强临床决策的有前景一步。
items.author_line: Girard JM, Kebe GY, Morency L, De la Torre F, Liebenthal E, Baker JT

items.title: Generative model of patient health states and pan-cancer risk stratification
items.abstract_or_text: While large language models are powerful generators of new text, forecasting disease progression from longitudinal health histories remains a challenging problem. We introduce GenEHR, an autoregressive generative model trained on electronic health records (EHRs) from millions of patients that explicitly represents the irregular time intervals between visits when forecasting future clinical events. We combine the general-purpose patient representation learned during foundational training with parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for the task of pan-cancer risk stratification. In five large EHR cohorts supervised adaptation substantially improved prediction performance of a first cancer diagnosis within a five year horizon window. Our retrospective results support the evaluation of GenEHR-CancerRisk as a prospective clinical decision-support tool for prioritizing patients for risk-based screening for aggressive cancer types, such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.
items.summary_zh: GenEHR 在数百万患者 EHR 上训练，用于五个大型队列中五年首发癌症风险的回顾性分层。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型显式表示就诊间隔并在多队列评估，但临床应用仅是前瞻性评估设想，不能据此直接用于筛查决策。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管 large language models 擅长生成新文本，但从纵向健康史预测疾病进展仍是一项挑战。我们引入 GenEHR：一种在数百万患者的电子健康记录（EHRs）上训练的 autoregressive generative model；它在预测未来临床事件时显式表示就诊之间不规则的时间间隔。我们将基础训练期间学习到的通用患者表征与 parameter-efficient supervised adaptation 相结合，用于泛癌风险分层任务。在五个大型 EHR cohorts 中，supervised adaptation 显著提高了对五年时间窗内首次癌症诊断的预测性能。我们的回顾性结果支持将 GenEHR-CancerRisk 作为前瞻性临床决策支持工具进行评估，以优先筛选胰腺癌和卵巢癌等侵袭性癌种的风险筛查患者。

items.title: Environment-Aware DNA Language Model for Stress-Responsive Genomic Prioritization in Maize
items.abstract_or_text: Abiotic stresses such as heat and drought severely reduce maize productivity, yet identifying genomic regions that confer stress resilience remains a challenge. Inspired by advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for capturing regulatory patterns through large-scale pre-training on DNA sequences. However, their application to plant stress-response analysis remains unexplored. This study presents an environment-aware DNA-LLM that adapts AgroNT, a transformer-based GFM pre-trained on diverse plant genomes, by incorporating stress-specific prompt tokens. Through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, the model learns stress-conditioned sequence representations that form distinct clusters in the embedding space across environmental contexts. By combining stress-induced shifts in these sequence representations relative to control conditions with transformer attention patterns, we prioritized putative heat- and drought-responsive genomic regions associated with grain yield in the Genomes-to-Fields (G2F) panel. Prioritized regions were supported by spatiotemporal differential gene-expression evidence and overlap with stress-associated quantitative trait loci. They were further characterized through transcription-factor family analysis and regulatory motif enrichment. Attention-guided analysis additionally identified stress-associated motifs enriched within model-emphasized sequence regions. Overall, the prioritized loci were proximal to genes involved in transcriptional regulation, signaling, and metabolic pathways relevant to abiotic-stress adaptation, demonstrating the potential of stress-conditioned transformer-based sequence modeling for environment-aware genome-to-phenome analysis.
items.summary_zh: 环境感知 DNA-LLM 通过胁迫特异 prompt tokens，对玉米热和干旱响应基因组区域进行优先排序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型结果以 G2F panel、时空差异表达、QTL 重叠和 motif 富集交叉支持，但仍是候选位点优先级而非功能因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 热和干旱等非生物胁迫会严重降低玉米生产力，但鉴定赋予胁迫韧性的基因组区域仍具挑战。受 Large Language Models（LLMs）进展启发，Genomic Foundation Models（GFMs）近来成为通过植物 DNA 序列大规模预训练捕获调控模式的一种有前景方法。然而，其在植物胁迫响应分析中的应用仍未被探索。本研究提出环境感知 DNA-LLM：通过纳入胁迫特异的 prompt tokens，对在多种植物基因组上预训练的 transformer-based GFM AgroNT 进行适配。通过 parameter-efficient fine-tuning，模型学习了在不同环境语境下于 embedding space 中形成不同簇的胁迫条件序列表征。通过结合相对于对照条件的这些序列表征胁迫诱导位移与 transformer attention patterns，我们在 Genomes-to-Fields（G2F）panel 中优先识别了与 grain yield 相关的候选热和干旱响应基因组区域。优先区域得到时空差异 gene-expression 证据和与胁迫相关 quantitative trait loci 重叠的支持。它们还通过 transcription-factor family analysis 和 regulatory motif enrichment 得到表征。attention-guided analysis 还识别出在模型强调的序列区域内富集的胁迫相关 motifs。总体而言，优先位点邻近参与非生物胁迫适应相关转录调控、信号传导和代谢通路的基因，表明基于胁迫条件 transformer 的序列建模可用于环境感知的 genome-to-phenome 分析。
items.author_line: Pal, D., Odell, A., Singh, A., Thompson, A. M., Ross, A., Thessen, A.

items.title: GEM-GPT Enables Personalized Cell Type-Resolved Therapeutic Design for Systems Pharmacology
items.abstract_or_text: Generative AI is transforming drug discovery, yet most approaches follow one-drug-one-target paradigms ill-suited to the heterogeneity of chronic, systemic diseases. Systems pharmacology offers an alternative, but generative tools designed for it remain scarce. We introduce GEM-GPT, a transcriptomics-guided framework that generates personalized therapeutic candidate molecules intended to shift cell type-specific disease states toward healthy phenotypes. GEM-GPT uses a biology-inspired deep fusion architecture that couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT, modeling cell type-specific chemical-gene interactions throughout molecule generation rather than through fixed conditioning. Across bulk and single-cell chemical perturbations and CRISPR knock-out signatures, GEM-GPT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, produces cell type-resolved molecules, and generalizes to unseen cellular contexts. In a case study on opioid use disorder (OUD), it generates novel candidates, recovers FDA-approved OUD-related drugs absent from training, and yields predicted binders to OUD-related targets. GEM-GPT bridges single-cell omics and molecular generation for personalized, cell-type-resolved, systems-aware therapeutic design.
items.summary_zh: GEM-GPT 将单细胞转录组 foundation model 与 molecular GPT 融合，生成旨在改变细胞类型特异疾病状态的候选分子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨扰动和 CRISPR 数据的比较及 OUD 案例展示方法潜力，但生成分子的活性和安全性尚未获得实验或临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式 AI 正在改变药物发现，但大多数方法遵循 one-drug-one-target 范式，不适合慢性系统性疾病的异质性。系统药理学提供了一种替代方案，但为其设计的生成式工具仍很少。我们引入 GEM-GPT：一个由转录组指导的框架，可生成旨在将细胞类型特异疾病状态转向健康表型的个体化治疗候选分子。GEM-GPT 使用一种受生物学启发的 deep fusion architecture，将 single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model 与 molecular GPT 耦合，在整个分子生成过程中建模细胞类型特异的 chemical-gene interactions，而非采用固定条件化。在 bulk 和 single-cell chemical perturbations 以及 CRISPR knock-out signatures 中，GEM-GPT 优于 state-of-the-art baselines，产生细胞类型分辨的分子，并能泛化至未见 cellular contexts。在 opioid use disorder（OUD）案例研究中，它生成新候选物，找回训练集中不存在的 FDA-approved OUD-related drugs，并产生针对 OUD-related targets 的预测结合物。GEM-GPT 将 single-cell omics 与 molecular generation 连接起来，用于个体化、细胞类型分辨且系统感知的治疗设计。
items.author_line: Zhang, S., Ohlan, R., Mottaqi, M., Xie, L.

items.title: Phase separation behavior of TDP-43 governs its protein interactome and regulation of alternative splicing
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract TDP-43 is a nuclear RNA-binding protein that regulates RNA metabolism, including alternative splicing. Its aggregation is a major pathological hallmark of several neurodegenerative diseases. TDP-43 undergoes phase separation (PS) and this condensation behavior may be linked to aggregate formation. Whether and how PS governs TDP-43’s RNA regulatory functions remains poorly understood. Here we utilized rationally designed mutations in the TDP-43 low complexity domain to tune TDP-43 PS, yielding a panel of TDP-43 variants with reduced propensity to form condensates (“PS-deficient”), and a panel forming irreversible, undynamic condensates (“solid-like”) in vitro and in cells. Two complementary interactomics approaches identified PS-dependent interactions between TDP-43 and key RNA regulatory factors, including splicing regulators and the RNA helicase UPF1, which show increased interactions with solid-like variants. Our results highlight that TDP-43 PS regulates RNA and protein homeostasis by modulating a subset of TDP-43-dependent alternative splicing events and by reshaping interactions with RNA regulatory factors.
items.summary_zh: 通过理性设计 TDP-43 低复杂度域突变，研究相分离如何重塑蛋白互作组和可变剪接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 两种互作组学方法把凝聚态性质与 RNA 调控因子相互作用相连，为神经退行性病理相关机制提供细胞与体外证据。
items.abstract_zh: TDP-43 是一种调控 RNA 代谢（包括 alternative splicing）的核 RNA-binding protein。其聚集是多种神经退行性疾病的主要病理特征。TDP-43 会发生 phase separation（PS），这种凝聚行为可能与聚集体形成相关。PS 是否以及如何支配 TDP-43 的 RNA 调控功能仍知之甚少。我们在此利用对 TDP-43 low complexity domain 的理性设计突变调节 TDP-43 PS，得到一组形成 condensates 倾向降低的 TDP-43 variants（“PS-deficient”），以及一组在体外和细胞中形成不可逆、无动态 condensates 的 variants（“solid-like”）。两种互补的 interactomics approaches 识别出 TDP-43 与关键 RNA regulatory factors（包括 splicing regulators 和 RNA helicase UPF1）之间依赖 PS 的相互作用；这些因素与 solid-like variants 的相互作用增加。我们的结果突出显示，TDP-43 PS 通过调节一部分 TDP-43-dependent alternative splicing events，并重塑其与 RNA regulatory factors 的相互作用，调控 RNA 和蛋白质稳态。

items.title: iPSC-Derived Chondroprogenitors as a Promising Cell Source for Cartilage Engineering: A Comparison with MSCs in Unmodified and Peptide-Functionalized Alginate Hydrogels
items.abstract_or_text: Articular cartilage degeneration is a hallmark of degenerative joint diseases, yet its limited regenerative capacity poses significant challenges for tissue engineering. While mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) are the most commonly employed cell type in cartilage tissue engineering, they exhibit donor variability, restricted expansion capacity, and tendencies toward fibrocartilage formation and hypertrophic differentiation. Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived chondroprogenitors (iCPs) represent a promising alternative, offering scalable production of developmentally relevant cells with intrinsic chondrogenic commitment. However, their performance within three-dimensional biomaterial scaffolds remains largely unexplored. Here, we compared chondrogenic differentiation of iCPs and MSCs within alginate hydrogels of varying stiffness (0.37 - 4.55 kPa) exhibiting physiologically relevant stress relaxation properties. Intermediate stiffness (2% alginate, ~2.17 kPa) optimally supported chondrogenesis for both cell types. While MSCs differentiated as single cells, iCPs spontaneously self-organized into cartilaginous aggregates without requiring a separate pellet pre-culture step, showing significantly higher hyaline indices and reduced COL10 expression, despite initial low viability in hydrogels. To further enhance chondrogenesis, we functionalized 2% alginate gels with RGD and HAVDI peptides mimicking integrin- and cadherin-mediated signaling. HAVDI/RGD functionalization significantly enhanced hyaline cartilage marker expression in both cell types, with iCPs exhibiting superior matrix composition characterized by elevated aggrecan and SOX9 expression and reduced COL10 and MMP13 compared to MSCs. These findings establish iCPs as a promising cell source for cartilage tissue engineering and disease modeling, particularly within biomaterials integrating mechanical and bioactive cues that recapitulate the native cartilage microenvironment.
items.summary_zh: 比较 iPSC-derived chondroprogenitors 与 MSCs 在不同刚度、肽功能化 alginate hydrogels 中的软骨分化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供支架参数、细胞自组织和软骨标记物的实验比较，为软骨工程和疾病建模的细胞来源选择提供前临床依据。
items.abstract_zh: 关节软骨退化是退行性关节疾病的标志，但其有限的再生能力给组织工程带来重大挑战。尽管 mesenchymal stem cells（MSCs）是软骨组织工程中最常用的细胞类型，但它们具有供体变异性、扩增能力受限，以及形成纤维软骨和发生肥大分化的倾向。human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived chondroprogenitors（iCPs）是一种有前景的替代选择，可规模化生产具有发育相关性且内在具有软骨分化承诺的细胞。然而，它们在三维生物材料支架内的表现仍很少被探索。我们在此比较 iCPs 和 MSCs 在具有生理相关 stress relaxation properties、刚度不同（0.37 - 4.55 kPa）的 alginate hydrogels 中的软骨分化。中等刚度（2% alginate，约2.17 kPa）最适合两种细胞的软骨分化。MSCs 以单细胞形式分化，而 iCPs 无需单独的 pellet pre-culture step 即自发组织成软骨样聚集体；尽管其在 hydrogels 中初始存活率较低，仍显示出显著更高的 hyaline indices 和更低的 COL10 表达。为进一步增强软骨分化，我们用模拟 integrin- 和 cadherin-mediated signaling 的 RGD 和 HAVDI peptides 对2% alginate gels 进行功能化。HAVDI/RGD 功能化显著增强两种细胞的 hyaline cartilage marker expression；与 MSCs 相比，iCPs 显示出更优的 matrix composition，其 aggrecan 和 SOX9 表达升高，而 COL10 和 MMP13 降低。这些发现确立 iCPs 是软骨组织工程和疾病建模的有前景细胞来源，尤其适用于整合了重现原生软骨微环境的机械和生物活性线索的 biomaterials。

items.abstract_or_text: ARC-AGI-4 will be a benchmark for autonomous open-ended innovation. It will continue our commitment to open-source, giving the research community a shared target for progress that benefits all of humanity. Despite rapid model progress, humans still significantly outperform AI at open-ended invention. Open source is the foundation for that progress. Any coordinated effort by the AI industry to reduce openness or concentrate access to frontier AI would undermine that positive-sum future.
items.summary_zh: ARC Prize 官方账号宣布，ARC-AGI-4 将定位为“自主开放式创新”的基准，并强调开源与共享评测目标。人类仍明显强于 AI 的表述是该机构在帖文中的判断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖提供了下一代 ARC 基准的明确定位，并把开放性与评测基础设施联系起来；其对能力差距和产业开放性的结论仍应视为发布方立场。
items.abstract_zh: ARC-AGI-4 将成为衡量自主开放式创新的基准。它将延续我们对开源的承诺，为研究社区提供一个共同的进步目标，惠及全人类。尽管模型进展迅速，人类在开放式发明上的表现仍明显优于 AI。开源是这一进步的基础。AI 行业任何削弱开放性或集中前沿 AI 获取权的协同行动，都将损害这种正和的未来。
items.author_line: ARC Prize

items.abstract_or_text: Someone open sourced an entire animal. Not a model of an animal. The animal. A fruit fly, rebuilt joint by joint from microscopy, that walks, grips, flies and lands inside a physics engine running on your laptop. It's called flybody. Built by Google DeepMind and HHMI Janelia, published in Nature, and sitting on GitHub under Apache 2.0 right now.
items.summary_zh: 帖文称 Google DeepMind 与 HHMI Janelia 制作了名为 flybody 的数字果蝇：它由显微数据逐关节重建，可在本地物理引擎中完成多种动作，并已发表于 Nature、以 Apache 2.0 许可证置于 GitHub。候选文本未附论文或代码链接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若原帖所述来源与开放状态可由论文和代码库复核，这会是连接连接组、具身模拟与可复用研究资产的重要案例；动作能力与实现细节不应仅据这条二手帖文外推。
items.abstract_zh: 有人把一整只动物开源了。不是一个动物模型，而是这只动物本身。一只果蝇从显微图像出发被逐关节重建，在你笔记本电脑上运行的物理引擎中行走、抓握、飞行和着陆。它叫 flybody，由 Google DeepMind 和 HHMI Janelia 构建，发表于 Nature，现在以 Apache 2.0 许可证放在 GitHub 上。
items.author_line: Zyvex

items.title: @fchollet：I hope the proposals by frontier labs to pace AI research stem from a genuine concern for safety and a recognition of th
items.abstract_or_text: I hope the proposals by frontier labs to pace AI research stem from a genuine concern for safety and a recognition of the potential risks posed by future models, rather than a strategic effort to consolidate power and permanently solidify the market dominance of a few top players. If these efforts are genuine, then oversight must take a more democratic and accountable form, with both national and international components, similar to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission in the US and the International Atomic Energy Agency internationally. Two potential warning signs of regulatory capture: 1. Calls to ban open-source AI. 2. Attempts to hinder non-frontier research.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 表示，他希望前沿实验室放缓 AI 研究的提议源于安全关切而非巩固市场力量；他主张监督应更民主、可问责，并列出限制开源和阻碍非前沿研究两项可能的监管俘获信号。这是作者的政策观点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点把风险治理、竞争结构和研究开放性置于同一讨论框架，提出了可供专业社群检验与反驳的具体制度判断，而非能力事实声明。
items.abstract_zh: 我希望前沿实验室提出放缓 AI 研究的建议，源于对安全的真切关心和对未来模型潜在风险的认识，而不是为了集中权力、永久巩固少数顶尖公司的市场主导地位而作出的战略努力。如果这些努力是真诚的，那么监督必须采取更民主、更可问责的形式，并同时具有国家和国际层面，类似美国核管理委员会和国际原子能机构。有两种监管俘获的潜在警告信号：1. 呼吁禁止开源 AI。2. 试图阻碍非前沿研究。
items.author_line: François Chollet

items.abstract_or_text: Proud of this statement from Dario on pacing - as anyone close to the technology knows, AI seems to be on a trajectory to progress far faster than the rate at which society can adapt to its capabilities and risks. AI is an amazingly positive technology - and an incredibly powerful one. For us to truly benefit from it we need to treat it seriously. We need to find ways to slow the frontier of development, such that we can better deal with collective action problems and buy ourselves more time for understanding the properties of these systems and how they need to be handled. On a personal note, as a parent of young children, it is an everyday crazymaking occurrence to reflect on how little the development of literal superintelligence is regulated relative to the food and toys I buy for my children.
items.summary_zh: Jack Clark 支持 Dario 关于“减速”的声明，认为 AI 能力进展可能快于社会适应风险和能力的速度；他据此主张放慢前沿开发，以处理集体行动问题并争取理解系统性质的时间。这是作者的规范性判断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文具体说明了“减速”主张所针对的社会适应与集体行动机制，为能力发展速度和治理节奏之间的关系提供了一种可讨论的论证。
items.abstract_zh: 我为 Dario 关于减速的这份声明感到自豪——任何接近这一技术的人都知道，AI 似乎正沿着一条进步速度远快于社会适应其能力和风险速度的轨道前行。AI 是一种极为积极的技术，也是一种极其强大的技术。要真正从中获益，我们需要认真对待它。我们需要找到放慢前沿开发的方法，以便更好地处理集体行动问题，并为理解这些系统的性质及其应如何被处置争取更多时间。就个人而言，作为年幼孩子的父亲，每天想到字面意义上的超级智能开发所受监管比我给孩子买的食品和玩具还少得多，都会让我近乎抓狂。
items.author_line: Jack Clark

items.abstract_or_text: Some notes from the Fields Medal letter today (https://mathandai.org/). Generally saying that AI models riffling through solving these problems gives 1 bit of signal while killing the 99 other bits of conceptual understanding that mathematicians would have extracted from fighting with these problems
items.summary_zh: Thom Wolf 就一封与 AI 和数学有关的公开信写下读后注：他概括其主张为，模型快速求解问题只带来“1 比特”信号，却会损失数学家通过与问题搏斗获得的大量概念理解。这是作者对所链接公开信的转述。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点将讨论从答案是否正确推进到研究训练中概念形成的价值；“1 比特/99 比特”是修辞性概括而非候选文本中的实证度量。
items.abstract_zh: 关于今天那封菲尔兹奖得主公开信的一些笔记（https://mathandai.org/）。总体意思是，AI 模型快速翻找并求解这些问题，只获得 1 比特信号，却扼杀数学家通过同这些问题搏斗本可提取出的另外 99 比特概念理解。
items.author_line: Thomas Wolf
